probe_scope: Rules temporarily enabled by ESLint CLI flags for stdin input only. Project configuration and source files were not changed.

cases.input:
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
export function DesignProbe() { return <Button className="bg-red-500 p-4">Probe</Button> }

findings.message: "bg-red-500" uses the raw Tailwind palette. Nearest theme tokens: bg-destructive. Use one of those, or declare --color-<name> in src/index.css for a new color.

"bg-red-500" is not allowed on <Button>: <Button> owns its color. Use a variant: default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive, link. Add a new variant in src/components/ui/button.tsx only if the design explicitly calls for a treatment none of these provides.

"p-4" is not allowed on <Button>: <Button> owns its spacing. Use a size (default, xs, sm, lg, icon, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-lg), or margin here or gap on the parent for space around it. Add a size in src/components/ui/button.tsx only if the design explicitly calls for one.
